title: 第92章 既然来了，就都别想走了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐逸扭头看向萧棣，你刚才还一副恨不得弄死你爹的样子，现在这么激动干嘛？锦衣卫直属皇帝，皇帝出行安全难道不是由锦衣卫负责？宁川看出唐逸的疑惑，不由拍了拍额头，忘记了，这家伙当上锦衣卫，也只是两天的时间而已。“以往有关陛下出行的事，都是由御前司负责，锦衣卫协助，现在直接改由锦衣卫负责的，还是第一次。”“而且，陛下钦点……由你陪伴在他身侧，负责他的安全！”宁川盯着唐逸，他大概能猜测出皇帝的意思，这是想要将这次护卫的功劳，都给唐逸呢。可是陛下哎，咱们玩归玩闹归闹，别拿生命开玩笑行吗？直到你想扶持唐逸，但你也不用拿自己涉险吧？你就这么相信这家伙？他虽然懂一点乱七八糟的东西，但武功一言难尽啊！随便一个刺客，都能让他躺板板。唐逸听到宁川的话，也是呆在当场。他负责呆在皇帝的身边，保护皇帝的安全？开什么玩笑？暗京楼的目标是皇帝，而他也在暗京楼的暗杀榜，再加上沈园诗会他小诗仙的身份曝光……妈的，两个目标人物聚在一起，简直就是给暗京楼安排的天赐良机。“陛下疯了？！”唐逸满脸错愕。“嘘，你小子给我注意点，不要命了？”宁川捂住唐逸的嘴，没好气道：“这是陛下看重你，如此这次沈园诗会结束后，陛下给你升职那些大臣也不敢有不满。”“既然圣旨下达了，那你准备一下，沈园诗会就跟在陛下的身边吧！”唐逸闻言嘴角都在轻微抽搐，这个活不好搞，这是个要命的活。“我能拒绝吗？”唐逸磕着牙花子，道：“而且，咱们一处二处不是只负责查案吗？要咱们负责查案的来搞安保？他专业也不对口啊！”宁川冷笑一声，道：“拒绝？抗旨不遵你会死得更惨。”“还有查案，呵，你不是说案子已经破了吗？”“案子破了，还查什么查？”宁川一甩衣袖转身离开，虽说这家伙进锦衣卫，他是吃了不少好处。可是，自从这家伙进了锦衣卫，他也过得很糟心啊！“老萧，你爹是不是有个大病？”唐逸扭头看向萧棣，有些咬牙切齿。萧棣这时也是懵的，怒道：“你问我？我问谁去？但有一点是可以确定的，他就是个赌徒，疯子。”两人大眼瞪小眼，也没想明白炎文帝到底要干嘛。想不清楚，唐逸也懒得再想，不是说帝王心海底针吗？要是皇帝的心思这么容易让他猜透了，那估计皇帝的那些对手，早将他生吞活剥了。但是，唐逸还是拉着萧棣进了宁川办公处，将暗京楼高手大量在京都聚集的消息，以及自己的猜测告诉了宁川。却发现，宁川半点不震惊，一副老子早知道的样子。唐逸当时就无语了，也对，连吴勇这种伪装好的北狄坐探，刚刚进京都就被锦衣卫抓了，没道理暗京楼这么大动静，锦衣卫没一点消息。“我明白你的意思，你是想说找到暗京楼杀手的落脚点，然后将他们一举歼灭？”宁川明白唐逸的意思，既然暗京楼没安好心，那就主动出击，将暗京楼给灭了。唐逸点头，道：“以锦衣卫对京都的掌控力，摸清楚暗京楼杀手的位置，应该不难吧？”萧棣眼睛一亮，此计可行，他也不喜欢被动挨打。然而，宁川却靠着椅子，双腿交叠搭在桌上嗤笑起来。“你这想法很久以前，就有人想要去做了。”“可这么多年了，你说为什么锦衣卫没有这么做？”唐逸和萧棣相视一眼，眉头都不由皱了起来。难道，是他们想得太简单了？宁川脸色微沉，声音冰冷道：“要找到暗京楼的杀手，不难，难的是，如何在同一时间，将暗京楼所有杀手全部杀了。”“你以为暗京楼的杀手，都聚集在一处吗？”“错了，他们的安置遍布整个京都，但凡有一处发生意外，便会有人报信。”“而收到消息的杀手会在所在区域，开始无视规则肆意屠杀，无论男女老少，都会成为他们的刀下亡魂。”宁川盯着唐逸，一字一句道：“你觉得一个高手，一个时辰能杀多少手无寸铁的百姓？”闻言，唐逸脸色顿时阴沉下来，萧棣也是紧攥拳头，骨头嘎嘣作响。“什么？”唐逸和萧棣震惊看着宁川，宁川的话让他们身心俱震。暗京楼竟然这么残忍和暴戾，暴露了不逃命，而是滥杀无辜？！宁川竖起了两根手指，道：“两千人。因为，二十年前北狄南下的时候，暗京楼在京都做过。”“一个晚上，死在暗京楼手中的百姓超过一万人，整整一万人。”“虽然对外宣称是北狄谍子做的，但我们都很清楚，是暗京楼的杀手所为，一颗人头二十两……”话没说完，萧棣已经一拳砸在桌上，眼睛泛红：“这帮畜生，该死！”唐逸已经愣住，眼中杀意翻涌，他终于明白为何这些年暗京楼为何能肆无忌惮了，因为这群人已经不配称为人了。同时，一股寒意从脚底板直蹿唐逸的脑袋，让他身体都止不住微微颤抖。一个人一个时辰能杀两千平民百姓，而这些暗京楼在聚在京都的杀手，足有三百余人。这要是出现意外，一个时辰就能将京都变成一座鬼蜮。当然，要围杀三百杀手，对京都十几万军队来说不是什么难事……前提是，得牺牲成千上万的无辜百姓为代价。这个代价不是一般的大，而且在天子脚下发生这样的惨案，那皇帝，朝廷，都会失去民心。这几乎是个无解的局！“唐逸，想要我支持你主动出击，首先你要有办法保证，能将这些臭虫在最短的时间内，一举击杀。”“将损失，降低到最小，你能做到？”宁川抬头看向唐逸。唐逸沉吟了一下，道：“我需要请假，我要回家做一个大杀器。”“接下来两天，让锦衣卫的兄弟将暗京楼所有安全屋都找出来，我要送他们一份大礼。”“既然他们来了京都，那这一次……就都别想走了！”前世可是特种兵，做一点炸弹，对他来说就跟玩儿一样。
content_en: Tang Yi turned to look at Xiao Di, you looked like you wanted to kill your father just now, why are you so excited now?Jin Yiwei is directly under the emperor. Isn't it the responsibility of Jin Yiwei to ensure the emperor's travel safety?Ning Chuan saw Tang Yi's confusion and couldn't help but pat his forehead, forgetting that this guy had only been a royal guard for two days."In the past, matters related to His Majesty's travels were handled by the Imperial Secretary, with the assistance of the Jin Yiwei. Now, this is the first time that the Jin Yiwei is directly in charge." "And, His Majesty has appointed you... to accompany him and be responsible for his safety!" Ning Chuan stared at Tang Yi. He could probably guess what the emperor meant. He wanted to give Tang Yi all the credit for the guard.But Your Majesty, let's go back to having fun and have fun, don't make fun of your life, okay?Until you want to support Tang Yi, but you don't have to put yourself at risk, right?Do you really believe this guy?Although he knows a few messy things, his martial arts skills are hard to describe!Any assassin can put him on the spot.When Tang Yi heard Ning Chuan's words, he also stayed on the spot.He is responsible for staying by the emperor's side and protecting the emperor's safety?Are you kidding me?An Jing Tower's target is the emperor, and he is also on An Jing Tower's assassination list. In addition, the identity of the little poetry fairy in Shen Yuan Poetry Club has been exposed... Damn it, the two target figures coming together is simply a god-given opportunity arranged for An Jing Tower."Your Majesty is crazy?!" Tang Yi was shocked."Shh, you boy, please pay attention to me, are you going to die?" Ning Chuan covered Tang Yi's mouth and said angrily: "This is because His Majesty values ​​you, so after the Shen Yuan Poetry Contest is over, the ministers who are promoted by His Majesty will not be dissatisfied." "Now that the imperial edict has been issued, prepare yourself, and the Shen Yuan Poetry Contest will follow His Majesty!" The corners of Tang Yi's mouth twitched slightly when he heard this. This job is not easy to do, it is a fatal job."Can I refuse?" Tang Yi gnashed his teeth and said, "Besides, aren't our First and Second Divisions only responsible for investigating cases? Do you want the person who is responsible for investigating cases to provide security? He is not professional enough!" Ning Chuan sneered and said: "Reject? Resist?If you don't obey the order, you will die worse." "There is still an investigation.Oh, didn't you say that the case has been solved?" "The case has been solved, what else is there to investigate?" Ning Chuan fluttered his sleeves and turned away. Although this guy got a lot of benefits from entering Jinyiwei.However, since this guy entered Jinyiwei, he has been having a terrible time!"Old Xiao, does your father have a serious illness?" Tang Yi turned to look at Xiao Di, gritting his teeth.Xiao Di was also confused at this time and said angrily: "You ask me? Who am I going to ask? But one thing is for sure, he is a gambler and a madman." The two of them stared at each other, not thinking about what Emperor Yanwen wanted to do.He couldn't think clearly, and Tang Yi didn't bother to think about it anymore. Wasn't it said that the emperor's heart was as deep as the bottom of his heart?If the emperor's thoughts were so easy for him to guess, then the emperor's opponents would probably have eaten him alive.However, Tang Yi still took Xiao Di into Ningchuan's office and told Ningchuan the news that a large number of masters from the Anjing Tower gathered in Kyoto, as well as his speculations.But I found that Ning Chuan was not shocked at all, and looked like I had known it for a long time.Tang Yi was speechless at that time, and that's right. Even Wu Yong, a disguised detective in Beidi, was arrested by the Jin Yiwei just after he entered Kyoto. There was no reason why there was such a big movement in the Anjing Tower, and the Jin Yiwei had no news at all."I understand what you mean. Do you want to find the foothold of Anjinglou's killers and annihilate them in one fell swoop?" Ning Chuan understood what Tang Yi meant. Since Anjinglou had no good intentions, he would take the initiative and destroy Anjinglou.Tang Yi nodded and said: "With Jinyiwei's control over Kyoto, it shouldn't be difficult to figure out the location of the Anjing Tower killer, right?" Xiao Di's eyes lit up, this strategy was feasible, and he didn't like to be beaten passively.However, Ning Chuan leaned on the chair, crossed his legs on the table and sneered."Someone has wanted to do your idea a long time ago." "But after so many years, why don't you think Jin Yiwei has done this?" Tang Yi and Xiao Di looked at each other and frowned.Could it be that they think too simply?Ning Chuan's face darkened and he said in a cold voice: "It's not difficult to find the killers of Anjing Tower. What's difficult is how to kill all the killers of Anjing Tower at the same time." "Do you think the killers of Anjing Tower are all gathered in one place?" "That's wrong. Their placements are all over Kyoto. If there is an accident somewhere, someone will report it." "And I received a report."The killers who heard the news will start to massacre indiscriminately in the area, regardless of men, women, or children." Ning Chuan stared at Tang Yi and said word by word: "How many unarmed people do you think a master can kill in an hour?" Upon hearing this, Tang Yi's face suddenly darkened, and Xiao Di clenched his fists, his bones cracking."What?" Tang Yi and Xiao Di looked at Ning Chuan in shock. Ning Chuan's words shocked them both physically and mentally.An Jinglou could be so cruel and violent, instead of running for his life after being exposed, he would kill innocent people indiscriminately?!Ning Chuan raised two fingers and said: "Two thousand people. Because twenty years ago when Beidi went south, Anjinglou did it in Kyoto." "In one night, more than 10,000 people died at the hands of Anjinglou, a total of 10,000 people." "Although it was claimed that Beidi spies did it, we all know that it was Anjinglou.What Lou's killer did, one head is twenty taels..." Before he could finish his words, Xiao Di punched the table, his eyes turned red: "Damn it, these beasts!" Tang Yi was stunned, with murderous intent surging in his eyes. He finally understood why An Jinglou has been so unscrupulous in these years, because these people no longer deserve to be called human beings.At the same time, a chill rushed from the soles of his feet to Tang Yi's head, causing his body to tremble slightly.One person can kill two thousand civilians in one hour, and there are more than three hundred of these assassins gathered in the capital.If something unexpected happens, Kyoto can be transformed into a ghost town within an hour.Of course, it is not difficult for Kyoto's hundreds of thousands of troops to round up and kill three hundred killers... The premise is that thousands of innocent people have to be sacrificed.This price is not ordinary high, and if such a tragedy happens at the feet of the emperor, the emperor and the court will lose the support of the people.This is almost an unsolvable situation!"Tang Yi, if you want me to support you in taking the initiative, you must first have a way to ensure that you can kill these bugs in the shortest possible time." "Can you reduce the losses to the minimum?" Ning Chuan looked up at Tang Yi.Tang Yi
